description:
Uploads local files and returns media_urls to pass to planify_create_post. Use this for anything an agent has just produced — rendered slides, a chart, an exported video — which lives on disk and has no public URL yet.

Files are sent in the order given, and that order is the order they appear in the post: for an Instagram carousel, files[0] is the first slide.

Prefer this over planify_upload_media_from_url unless the file is already published somewhere public — uploading directly avoids having to host the image before the post exists.

files.description: Up to 10 files, in the order they should appear in the post.

data_base64.description: The file's bytes, base64-encoded. Use when the content is not on disk.

filename.description: Name to store it under. Taken from `path` when omitted; required with data_base64.

mime_type.description: Content type. Guessed from the filename when omitted.

path.description: Absolute path to a file on this machine. Either this or data_base64.

name: planify_upload_media
title: Planify: upload an image or video from this machine
